name: AnorTech Inc.
summary: AnorTech Inc., established in 2000 and based in Vancouver, acquires, explores and develops mineral resources in Greenland. It wholly owns the Gronne Bjerg anorthosite project and holds 31.1% of the White Mountain anorthosite mine. It also develops anorthosite-based products such as waste-free alumina, carbon dioxide-free cement and thermal storage concrete. It was formerly Hudson Resources Inc. until March 2024.
